scope: partial keystream reproduction only; not full cipher reproduction or security attack

ode.note: step size and solver are not specified by the paper; parameters are an example in the paper, not verified encryption settings

reproducibility_caveats: The article does not state an ODE solver or step size.
This test uses one grayscale NASA smoke-test image resized to 64x64, not the paper dataset.
Only SHA seed derivation and chaotic sequence generation were implemented; scrambling, DNA encoding/diffusion, inverse, and key exchange were not.
Results characterize the effect of two conflicting Eq. 17 interpretations under one explicit numerical setting; they are not claimed as the authors original output.
